symbols.read: Price has pushed to 743.04, extending the recovery further above the 737.2–737.9 bullish FVG and keeping all four bullish FVGs (725.47–726.85, 729.1–730.29, 731.64–732.87, 737.2–737.9) intact as a rising support floor — the bearish case is weaker again versus the prior read. The 4H stays bearish and the combined signal remains HOLD, so the 1H still won't confirm the downtrend, and the short at 758.57 remains MISSED with no entry trigger. Immediate supply is still the 762.83–765.18 and 761.47–761.54 bearish FVGs overhead, with the 721.33 target sitting below the support stack. Bias stays bearish but conviction is weaker still — invalidation is a reclaim of 758.57, hard stop 775.89, and the BULLISH regime tag continues to conflict with the bearish structure.

Bias stays neutral-to-constructive: price at 82,572.00 remains above the 82,227.56 lower pivot, so the prior short invalidation holds and the SELL setup is still marked invalidated. The 4H is tagged bearish but the combined signal is HOLD, and the 1H print is mildly up (+0.11%, 82,574.75→82,664.01), so the bearish 4H/1H alignment has not re-formed — no change from the previous read's neutral stance. The two bull FVGs at 81,028.74–81,425.50 and 81,996.01–82,045.45 remain below as support, with the BULLISH regime still non-conflicting. Invalidation for the neutral bias is a 4H close back below 82,227.56, which would revive the short toward 77,730.00; until then 86,725.12 is the upside reference.

The SELL setup has expired without the 2,527.57 entry ever triggering, and the combined 4H+1H signal has shifted from confirmed bearish to HOLD even as the 4H direction and 1H downtrend remain bearish. Price has ground higher to 2,498.83, now testing the 2,465.96–2,468.65 bullish FVG from below after clearing the 2,449.65–2,464.60 pocket, which weakens the immediate downside case. The bias is now neutral-to-bearish rather than an active short: a close above 2,527.57 would confirm the bearish structure is broken and open the 2,551.76–2,556.06 bear FVG, while failure to reclaim 2,527.57 keeps the door open for a slide toward the 2,427.00–2,443.52 bull FVG and the 2,320.59 target. Invalidation of the remaining bearish lean is a close above 2,537.64, and the persistent BULLISH regime tag still argues against aggressive short sizing.

Bias stays bearish and the prior read is confirmed, not revised: price at 110.23 remains capped under the broken pivot at 115.26, 4H is still bearish, and 108.23 stays the downside objective. What changed is the demand stack again — the 109.64–109.89 bull FVG has been consumed and replaced by a much deeper bull FVG at 108.00–108.07, which now sits directly on top of the 108.23 target, while the overhead bear FVG has widened to 113.33–114.08 with the 112.89–113.14 gap still open beneath it. The last 1H is a marginal +0.04% (110.65→110.69), so momentum remains flat, not reversing, and combined reads HOLD with the SELL still flagged missed since entry and stop are both 115.26. Invalidation is unchanged: a 4H close above 115.26 flips the read neutral and voids the broken-pivot thesis, while losing 108.00 opens the next leg down — though the fresh bull FVG now sitting at that level means the 108.23 target is the first real test of whether the downside continues.

XAGUSD has edged up to 60.44, holding the grind above the 59.07 shelf and keeping the bearish setup sidelined for a second straight read — the watching stance is confirmed, not revised. The 4H stays bearish and combined 4H+1H remains HOLD, but the 1H trend is still up, and the bull FVG stack is unchanged at five zones spanning 59.12 to 60.02, with the top gap now sitting further beneath price as support. Bias stays bearish-but-pending: the short only re-arms on a break back below 58.50, with 58.72 the invalidation stop and 55.14 the target. Sustained trade above 58.72 keeps the setup sidelined, and 61.87 remains the upside pivot — a break above it flips the regime to a long setup with entry 61.87, stop 61.66, and target 65.24.

The watching long has activated: price pushed through the 4,184.39 trigger and is now holding above it at 4,194.53, so the bias flips from watching to confirmed long. The 4H direction has turned bullish from bearish, and two fresh bull FVGs (4,180.41–4,181.88 and 4,185.90–4,189.48) have formed directly beneath price, reinforcing the reclaimed pivot as support. The setup targets 4,302.24 with the stop at 4,176.54, and invalidation is now a break back below 4,184.39 that would fill the new FVGs and void the reclaim. Note the combined signal still reads HOLD and the regime is NEUTRAL, so this is a trigger-based long rather than a fully aligned trend entry.

Price is still pinned at 1.40, holding the 1.39 reclaim that flipped the bias last read, so the neutral-to-long stance stands and the 1.53 upper pivot remains the objective. The 1H trend has rolled to down and the regime tag stays BULLISH, leaving the 4H bearish direction as the lone bearish input — a conflict that keeps conviction low and the combined signal at HOLD. No open FVGs remain, so there is no structural shelf between here and 1.39; a close below 1.39 re-arms the 1.25 short with the 1.39 stop, while holding above it keeps 1.53 in play.
